items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I made friends with Panassié, Charles Delaunay, Curt Moore , Jack Dimitri.

ctx.x: Yep. 1948. It was very, very interesting. We were supposed to land in...at....what the hell were we

supposed to do, we were supposed to land in Nice. But then they couldn't land in Nice because of the conditions and we had to go all the way back to Orly Airport in Paris and we landed in Paris. Panassié was having a fit. Well actually, do you know that I went to Europe that year by accident. Again, you see. So perhaps fate has played a role with me on many evenings in my life and many points in my life, just as the lady saying to me, "Do you want to do some work?" Willie "the Lion" Smith was slated to go to…
"Sammy Price." He says, "Merveilleux Mayers" , you know, 'he's so marvelous with his ideas.' So, and that's how I happened to get to Europe..that first time.
